answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Every claim climbs the marble of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the nadir re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the terrace of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
